title: Paloma Business Treasury Terms: The Withdrawable Amount
content:
**Withdrawal clause.** The withdrawable amount of a Paloma Business balance is the balance, less the most recent ACH credit deposit while fewer calendar days than the plan's ACH hold days have passed since it was received, less a standing reserve of 1 percent of the payout principal debited in the three months before the day of the withdrawal, counted from the day after the same calendar day three months earlier up to and including that day, the standing reserve being rounded up to the cent, less the plan's withdrawal fee when the period's free withdrawals are already used, never below 0.00 and rounded half up to the cent.

### Definitions

| Term | Meaning |
|---|---|
| Balance | The account's USD balance on the day of the withdrawal |
| ACH deposit held back | The most recent ACH credit deposit, while fewer calendar days than the plan's ACH hold days have passed since the day it was received; otherwise nothing |
| Reserve basis | The payout principal debited from the balance in the three-month window |
| Reserve rate | 1 percent |
| Standing reserve | The reserve rate times the reserve basis, rounded up to the cent |
| Withdrawal fee | The plan's withdrawal fee, when the withdrawals already booked in the current billing period number at least the plan's free withdrawals; otherwise nothing |

### Worked figure (hypothetical Paloma Business Growth account: ACH hold 3 days, withdrawal fee 2.50 USD, 5 free withdrawals)

Day of the withdrawal 20 April. Balance 12500.00 USD. Most recent ACH credit deposit 4000.00 USD received 18 April. Payout principal debited from 21 January through 20 April 85432.10 USD. Withdrawals already booked in the period: 5.

1. ACH deposit held back: 2 calendar days have passed, fewer than 3, so 4000.00.
2. Standing reserve: 1 percent of 85432.10 is 854.321, rounded up to 854.33.
3. Withdrawal fee: the 5 free withdrawals are used, so 2.50.
4. Withdrawable amount: 12500.00 less 4000.00, less 854.33, less 2.50, that is 7643.17 USD.

Had the ACH credit deposit been received on 17 April, 3 calendar days would have passed and nothing would be held back.
